dramas.title: One Night with My Billionaire CEO
dramas.description:
Isabella is a kind-hearted career woman who never knows how to say no. On the night of her engagement anniversary, she catches her fiancé betraying her. Drunk and heartbroken, she ends up spending the night with Owen, the CEO of her company, who has been deliberately set up by someone.
When Isabella discovers she’s pregnant, the two strangers enter a marriage of convenience, each seeking what they need from the other. But as their fake marriage slowly turns real, the return of an old flame and a string of misunderstandings threaten to tear them apart—and their feelings spiral completely out of control.
Five years later, Isabella returns to the city with her young son, only to cross paths with Owen once again.
This time, can they find the love they lost all those years ago?
Five years later, Isabella returns with a little boy, and comes face-to-face with the man she never truly forgot. Can they finally uncover the truth and find their way back to each other?

dramas.title: The Real Heiress Versus the Phony Queen Bee
dramas.description:
Hailey Kaplan, the real heiress of the wealthy Kaplan family, hides her identity and transfers to an ordinary high school. She wishes to live a simple life and make sincere friends away from the spotlight of a rich family. However, Candice, the daughter of the family maid, discovers her secret and pretends to be the Kaplan heiress.
Candice teams up with her followers to bully Hailey constantly, flaunting her fake noble status everywhere. She sets up traps, spreads malicious rumors, and even drives a wedge between Hailey, her best friend Cece, and her crush Luke. After enduring endless troubles, Hailey decides to fight back.
She gathers solid evidence and exposes Candice’s lies and imposture one by one at campus debates, talent shows and the Spring Fling Dance. In the end, Candice and her accomplices get what they deserve. Hailey regains her true identity, clears her name, keeps her precious friendship, and falls in love with the kind and upright Luke.

dramas.title: My Billionaire Queen Sister
dramas.description: Billionaire Chloe attends her beloved brother Leo’s wedding in disguise. Her snobbish sister-in-law, Victoria, mistakes her for a mistress and humiliates her. When Leo learns the truth, he calls off the wedding on the spot to protect his sister. Bitter and vengeful, Victoria joins forces with Leo’s illegitimate half-brother and cold-hearted biological father to seize his tech company through Wall Street capital. But they don’t know that the most powerful force on Wall Street is Chloe....
